subject: TEST RESULT: exact security-epoch model passes 11/11 + 100k adversarial operations
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-security-rd-visual-security-authorization-20261002. Pure Kotlin Android-free model compiled with kotlinc 1.9.0/JRE 21 and passed 11/11 tests. Tests include source-faithful age-only baseline replay across lock, same-epoch allow, lock rejection, lock->unlock ABA non-resurrection, pre-lock in-flight capture rejection after lock and after lock/unlock, keyguard-showing/device-unlocked rejection, device-locked rejection, post-unlock fresh capture allow, and fixed-seed 100,000-operation adversarial invariant stream. Key invariant: authorize(frame) iff current security state permits Duo pixels AND frame.securityEpoch == current epoch. Prototype hashes: VisualSecurityGate.kt ace79bcb85735ee8dc0ca5d71af508d59b046415548a1c07d7cd9e5774d5e714; VisualSecurityGateTest.kt ac6df7704e5d551fbbae7418301a09a5ecce87fd4517c4f93f084587169b4ef7; test jar 23b23df4af5b76ec2ce90e2e63180112c9f545645bd27df348c30dfec66d849f; output 93408b261012e3209b8865c61f8c11b077abaa7168ed58794e00a205bf5856b6.
